name: The Great Flood
summary:
The Great Flood is a fast-paced real-time PvP strategy game with 1v1/2v2 battles. Summon divine beasts, deities and humanoid monsters, pair them with artifacts and defensive structures, and destroy enemy towers to win. Its Cluster Command System enables real-time hero-soldier coordination for precise tactics.

Strategic PvP: Easy to Learn, Hard to Master

Basic goal is deploy units, push towers, win. But mastering force timing, troop commitment and attrition balance needs practice.![{"height":720,"type":"vi
